answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond in the network kernel before it can trade: the bond is slashed if the agent is caught duplicating work or voting twice. A new identity must also pass a proof-of-useful-work task at the wharf gateway, where arrivals are checked against a mirror registry of device and behavior fingerprints, so one operator spinning up a thousand clones pays a thousand bonds and a thousand work proofs, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
